result.summary: The screen is mostly functional, but exhibits minor text truncation and inconsistent card asset rendering.

issues.description: The third restaurant title in the horizontal carousel is abruptly truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line wrapping or apply an ellipsis to signal truncated text cleanly.

issues.description: Card imagery mixes different illustration styles and placeholder graphics inconsistently.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image assets to either high-quality photography or a cohesive illustration style.
